_comment: Which Claude Desktop token each Ocean role drives.
Ocean role names come from ocean-source.json and never change.
Claude token names DO change between releases - that is what this file tracks.
'pin' = set the token to Ocean's exact colour.
'tint' = keep the app's own lightness, adopt Ocean's hue, so tokens Ocean has
no equivalent for do not stay warm/grey next to Ocean's cool surfaces.

--cds-gray-._comment: C = chroma_max * 4L(1-L) - fits Ocean's own surface chroma closely; hue lerps by lightness between Ocean's dark and light canvas hues.

--cds-hsl-gray-._comment: Parallel 'H S% L%' ramp behind --_gray-*, --z0..z6 and --t0..t7. Hue and saturation come from Ocean's canvas at each end of the range.

element_pins._comment: Sidebar: Claude derives it by darkening the page; Ocean's is lighter than its canvas.
Page background is consumed as hsl(var(--df-bg-page-hsl)).

rules._comment: Working indicators. The app gives both the running status dot and the three-dot cluster 'background: var(--cds-text-muted)', so they pulse grey. Ocean's accent is the blue t3code uses while a conversation is working.

Ready / finished. LITERAL, not a palette role - the Ocean palette has no green. messageAction (#5bd0d6) was used first but is cyan-teal and reads as blue next to the accent, which defeats the point of distinguishing it from 'running'. This is unambiguously green, at the accent's own lightness so it sits in the same family: oklch(0.78 0.20 145).
Hardcoded surface greys, retinted to Ocean's hue at their own lightness.
Hardcoded text colours. #3f9fff is a blue that is not Ocean's.
Inline code (backticks) is coloured with --danger-000, Claude's red. That is separate from any syntax theme, so removing this rule was a mistake.

Assistant markdown body text. The container is .prose - .ReactMarkdown does NOT exist in this app (probe: 0 instances), which is why earlier versions of this rule silently did nothing. DERIVED value: 42% Ocean text / 58% mutedForeground in OKLab. Ladder: #cbc9d2 lighter, #b1b2bc greyer.

Blockquotes and footnotes: clearly an aside. DERIVED, roughly 8% Ocean text / 92% mutedForeground - close to Claude's own muted token but keeping Ocean's hue. NOTE: steps under ~5% lightness are not perceptible here, so move this in visible jumps.

Text hierarchy, stated explicitly rather than left to inheritance. Three tiers: headings whitest, bold in between, body greyest. Headings are listed after the body rule so they win on equal specificity, and strong/b sits between the two.
rules.selector: .prose h1, .prose h2, .prose h3, .prose h4, .prose h5, .prose h6, .prose h1 *, .prose h2 *, .prose h3 *, .prose h4 *, .prose h5 *, .prose h6 *

rules._comment: Bold text: the middle tier - brighter than body, below headings. DERIVED: 70% Ocean text / 30% mutedForeground.
rules.selector: .prose strong, .prose b, .prose p strong, .prose li strong

raw_rules._comment: Inline code chip, copied from t3code's own rule: .chat-markdown :not(pre)>code { border:1px solid var(--contrast-border); background:var(--muted); color:var(--contrast-foreground); border-radius:.375rem; padding:.1rem .35rem; font-size:.75rem }. Resolved through the Ocean palette: muted #233544, border #405567, foreground #fffaff.
